title: Flat sheaf of modules on a ringed site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$ and $\mathcal F$ a sheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then $\mathcal F$ is *flat* if the functor $\Mod(\mathcal O)\to\Mod(\mathcal O)$, $\mathcal G\mapsto\mathcal G\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal F$ (the tensor product of sheaves of modules [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]) is exact.

mathlib_searches.results: `Module.Flat R M` (RingTheory/Flat/Basic.lean:113) for a module over a ring, with `Module.Flat.iff_rTensor_preserves_shortComplex_exact` (RingTheory/Flat/CategoryTheory.lean) in `ModuleCat R`; in CategoryTheory only `RepresentablyFlat` functors (Functor/Flat.lean), no flat object of a monoidal category and no flatness of sheaves or presheaves of modules
mathlib_searches.verdict: no match: Module.Flat is for modules over a single ring; flatness of a sheaf is not sectionwise flatness (sheafified tensor product)
